cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是英国广播公司世界服务部的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Valerie Sanderson, and at 13:00 GMT on Thursday, the 17th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是瓦莱丽·桑德森。9月17日星期四格林尼治时间13点，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: The United Nations is warning of a serious decline in the amount of fresh water stored on the Earth's surface, increasing chances of flooding and drought.
cues.zh: 联合国警告，地球表面储存的淡水量正在严重下降，洪水和干旱发生的可能性因此增加。

cues.en: In South Africa, police discovered the body of a woman to the east of Johannesburg, the ninth killing in two months.
cues.zh: 在南非，警方在约翰内斯堡以东发现一具女性尸体，这是两个月内发生的第九起杀人案。

cues.en: Canada's Prime Minister, Mark Carney, welcomes the European Union's proposal of associate membership.
cues.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼欢迎欧盟提出的准成员国身份方案。

cues.en: Also in this podcast...
cues.zh: 本期播客还将报道……

cues.en: I think that if we all create AIs that are able to act autonomously, that can define their own objectives,
cues.zh: 我认为，如果我们创造出能够自主行动、能够自行定义目标的人工智能，

cues.en: we're essentially seeding a new silicon species which will no doubt compete with us for resources.
cues.zh: 我们实际上是在播种一种新的硅基物种，它无疑会为了资源与我们竞争。

cues.en: A warning from the man in charge of Microsoft's artificial intelligence.
cues.zh: 微软人工智能负责人发出了警告。

cues.en: I think a lot of people in our country want change, but we haven't any instruments for this.
cues.zh: 我认为，我国很多人希望改变，但我们没有实现这一点的手段。

cues.en: We haven't voices.
cues.zh: 我们没有发声的渠道。

cues.en: I just want in all the world will be peace.
cues.zh: 我只希望全世界能够和平。

cues.en: People mostly can't change anything.
cues.zh: 人们大多什么也改变不了。

cues.en: We find out how people on the streets of Moscow view Russia's upcoming parliamentary elections.
cues.zh: 我们将了解莫斯科街头民众如何看待俄罗斯即将举行的议会选举。

cues.en: We begin with the stark warning from the United Nations about the Earth's dwindling water resources.
cues.zh: 我们先来看联合国关于地球水资源日益减少的严峻警告。

cues.en: Last year was one of the driest years for river discharge in 35 years.
cues.zh: 去年是35年来河流流量最少的年份之一。

cues.en: The past seven years have been abnormal river flows. Water-related extreme events continue to devastate communities and economies.
cues.zh: 过去七年的河流流量一直异常。与水有关的极端事件仍在摧毁社区和经济。

cues.en: Celeste Saulo, the Secretary-General of the World Meteorological Organization.
cues.zh: 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·萨乌洛。

cues.en: The organization's annual report says water storage, including groundwater, fresh water on land, and the water in rivers and lakes across the Earth's surface is declining.
cues.zh: 该组织的年度报告称，包括地下水、陆地淡水以及地表河流湖泊中的水在内，水储量正在下降。

cues.en: Extreme weather patterns caused by climate change are predicted to cause more floods and drought.
cues.zh: 预计气候变化造成的极端天气模式将带来更多洪水和干旱。

cues.en: And unreliable water resources disrupt the balance of Earth's natural water cycle by altering how water moves and evaporates.
cues.zh: 不稳定的水资源还会改变水的流动和蒸发方式，扰乱地球自然水循环的平衡。

cues.en: Our global affairs reporter Paul Moss told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的全球事务记者保罗·莫斯向我作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: The water cycle sounds simple. It's the process by which water evaporates from the Earth and then comes down again as rain.
cues.zh: 水循环听起来很简单：水从地球上蒸发，然后又以雨水的形式降下来。

cues.en: But what this report says is that it's become increasingly erratic, and that's because what can change is where the water comes from and how it falls.
cues.zh: 但报告称，水循环已经变得越来越不稳定，因为水从哪里来、以什么方式降落都可能发生变化。

cues.en: What happens is because we've got increasingly high temperatures because of climate change,
cues.zh: 由于气候变化导致气温不断升高，出现的情况是，

cues.en: fresh water is vanishing up into the sky from lakes and rivers.
cues.zh: 淡水正从湖泊和河流消失，升入天空。

cues.en: Many people, of course, depend on lakes and rivers for fresh water, both for drinking and for crops.
cues.zh: 当然，许多人依靠湖泊和河流获得淡水，用于饮用和种植作物。

cues.en: And those levels in lakes and rivers, the report shows, have fallen.
cues.zh: 报告显示，湖泊和河流的水位已经下降。

cues.en: But then there's the question of how and when the water falls.
cues.zh: 但接下来还有一个问题：水会以怎样的方式、在何时降落。

cues.en: What goes up, of course, must come down. And if there is more water in the sky in terms of clouds and humidity,
cues.zh: 当然，上升的水最终必须降下来。如果天空中的水分以云和湿气的形式增多，

cues.en: more water will fall, and that can cause flooding.
cues.zh: 降下的水就会增多，从而造成洪水。

cues.en: And I think this sometimes causes problems for people to understand. How can climate change cause both drought and flooding?
cues.zh: 我认为这有时令人难以理解：气候变化怎么会同时造成干旱和洪水？

cues.en: Well, that's because first of all, the water may go up slowly and then all fall in one go.
cues.zh: 首先，这是因为水可能缓慢上升，然后一次性全部降下。

cues.en: Or there may be greater water loss in hot places through evaporation, which then falls in colder countries as flooding.
cues.zh: 当然，炎热地区也可能有更多水分通过蒸发流失，随后在较冷的国家以洪水的形式降下。

cues.en: The UN report is focusing particularly on the changes to glaciers. Why are they so important?
cues.zh: 联合国报告尤其关注冰川的变化。冰川为什么如此重要？

cues.en: Glaciers, it explains, work as a buffer.
cues.zh: 报告解释说，冰川发挥着缓冲作用。

cues.en: And in fact, in a rather good graphic phrase, what it says is glaciers operate as the world's savings account in terms of water.
cues.zh: 事实上，报告用了一个很形象的说法：就水资源而言，冰川是全世界的储蓄账户。

cues.en: They freeze, obviously, when the weather's cold, more water freezes, and then when it's warmer in the summer, that water is released again.
cues.zh: 天气寒冷时，更多的水会结冰；到了夏天、天气变暖时，这些水又会释放出来。

cues.en: The trouble is, the glaciers are retreating, and it has a very good way of visualizing it.
cues.zh: 问题在于，冰川正在退缩，而报告用一种很直观的方式说明了这一点。

cues.en: What it says is that every year, the Earth's glaciers are losing water equivalent to 500 million, half a billion Olympic swimming pools.
cues.zh: 报告称，地球冰川每年流失的水量，相当于5亿个奥运会标准游泳池的容量。

cues.en: So what does that mean? Well, first of all, that current account I was describing to you is depleted. We don't have it anymore.
cues.zh: 这意味着什么？首先，我刚才描述的那个活期账户已经枯竭，我们已经没有这笔储备了。

cues.en: Secondly, those glaciers may break up and melt with catastrophic consequences,
cues.zh: 其次，这些冰川可能崩解并融化，造成灾难性后果，

cues.en: which we saw last month in Nepal, when a glacier probably melted and broke off, causing flash flooding that killed thousands,
cues.zh: 我们上个月在尼泊尔就看到了这种后果：冰川很可能融化并断裂，引发山洪，导致数千人死亡，

cues.en: and also towns and villages completely destroyed.
cues.zh: 城镇和村庄也被彻底摧毁。

cues.en: Paul, it's an obvious question, but can anything be done to avoid these water-related disasters?
cues.zh: 保罗，这是个显而易见的问题：有什么办法可以避免这些与水有关的灾害吗？

cues.en: One of the few pieces of good news in this report is that there is better monitoring of water levels, and so we can at least warn of trouble ahead.
cues.zh: 这份报告为数不多的好消息之一是，人们对水位的监测有所改善，至少可以提前发出危险预警。

cues.en: The problem is that there are poor warning systems in place in Africa and Asia,
cues.zh: 问题是，非洲和亚洲的预警系统并不完善，

cues.en: and those are precisely the areas which are going to be worse affected by all of this.
cues.zh: 而这些地区恰恰会受到这一切更严重的影响。

cues.en: In this country, we are prey. That was the social media post
cues.zh: “在这个国家，我们就是猎物。”这是那条社交媒体帖文的内容，

cues.en: of a South African woman after confirmation of the death of her friend and fellow runner
cues.zh: 发帖者是一名南非女性；她的朋友兼跑友去世的消息得到确认后，

cues.en: who didn't return last week, one victim in a spate of killings near Johannesburg.
cues.zh: 这名朋友上周未能回家，成为约翰内斯堡附近一连串凶杀案的受害者之一。

cues.en: Now police have discovered another body, once again, a female found half naked.
cues.zh: 现在，警方又发现了一具尸体，同样是一名被发现时几乎赤裸的女性。

cues.en: The BBC spoke to a woman at the scene.
cues.zh: 英国广播公司采访了现场的一名女性。

cues.en: Yo, I'm scared, I'm angry, I'm upset, I'm nervous, I am everything, I'm shattered.
cues.zh: 我害怕、愤怒、难过、紧张，百感交集，心都碎了。

cues.en: This is bad.
cues.zh: 这太糟糕了。

cues.en: We are even scared now to come out of your house.
cues.zh: 我们现在甚至害怕走出家门。

cues.en: We are scared to go to the shop. We are scared to go anywhere.
cues.zh: 我们害怕去商店，害怕去任何地方。

cues.en: We are no longer free in the country where we're supposed to be free and safe as women.
cues.zh: 在这个本应让女性自由、让我们安全的国家，我们已经不再自由。

cues.en: Similarities between eight previous deaths have raised concerns that they're connected and prompted renewed debate about gender-based violence
cues.zh: 此前八起死亡事件存在相似之处，引发了它们彼此相关的担忧，也再次引发了关于性别暴力的讨论。

cues.en: in South Africa, which has one of the highest rates of femicide in the world.
cues.zh: 南非的女性杀害率位居世界最高之列。

cues.en: I asked our correspondent in Johannesburg, Nomsa Maseko, what's known about the latest victim.
cues.zh: 我询问了驻约翰内斯堡记者诺姆萨·马塞科，最新这名受害者的情况。

cues.en: Well, this latest victim was found on a path where pedestrians normally walk,
cues.zh: 这名最新受害者是在行人通常经过的一条小路上被发现的。

cues.en: which has made police believe that her body was deliberately dumped there to be found by whoever is taking that route to walk.
cues.zh: 这让警方认为，她的尸体是被故意弃置在那里，供经过这条路的人发现。

cues.en: We have also been told by the police that she had a number of stab wounds on her body,
cues.zh: 警方还告诉我们，她身上有多处刺伤。

cues.en: and that her throat had been cut and that she was covered with a sheet,
cues.zh: 她的喉咙被割开，身上还盖着一张床单。

cues.en: and that she's believed to be in her early to mid-30s.
cues.zh: 据认为她的年龄在30岁出头到中段。

cues.en: She has not yet been identified at this stage,
cues.zh: 目前还无法确认她的身份。

cues.en: but the recent, you know, spate of killings of women in South Africa
cues.zh: 但近期南非接连发生的女性遇害事件，

cues.en: truly have caused a lot of anxiety and fear amongst women who say that it's very difficult for them to feel safe at home, even to feel safe outside,
cues.zh: 确实让女性感到焦虑和恐惧。她们说，自己很难在家中感到安全，甚至在户外也难以安心。

cues.en: because South Africa has one of the highest numbers of gender-based violence and femicide, and also domestic violence that is taking place in the country.
cues.zh: 因为南非的性别暴力、女性杀害以及家庭暴力发生率都位居世界最高之列。

cues.en: So you say there's been a spate of killings. Do police fear that there's a serial killer at large?
cues.zh: 你说发生了一连串杀人案。警方是否担心有连环杀手逍遥法外？

cues.en: Police have not said that there is a serial killer at large or not.
cues.zh: 警方没有说是否有连环杀手在逃。

cues.en: They said that they do not at this stage want to speculate on that.
cues.zh: 他们说，目前不想对此妄加猜测。

cues.en: They've also said that there is a high possibility that they're dealing with more than one perpetrator
cues.zh: 他们还说，很可能不止一名作案者涉案，

cues.en: and that there is also another possibility that these are copycat crimes in South Africa.
cues.zh: 另一种可能是，这是南非的模仿犯罪。

cues.en: So it sounds like the investigation is still all over the place for now.
cues.zh: 听起来，目前调查仍然没有明确方向。

cues.en: But I spoke with the police commissioner a few minutes ago, and she told me that police were following up on positive leads,
cues.zh: 但几分钟前我采访了警察局长，她告诉我，警方正在跟进有价值的线索。

cues.en: and that they did not want to give out sensitive information at this rate.
cues.zh: 她还说，警方目前不愿透露敏感信息。

cues.en: Do women in South Africa feel the government is doing enough to address this whole issue of femicide in the country?
cues.zh: 南非女性是否认为政府已采取足够措施，解决女性杀害这一问题？

cues.en: Women of South Africa feel failed because they're saying that not so long ago President Cyril Ramaphosa put together a gender commission
cues.zh: 南非女性感到政府辜负了她们，因为她们说，就在不久前，总统西里尔·拉马福萨成立了性别委员会，

cues.en: which was supposed to, you know, focus on such crimes against women that are actually taking place in South Africa.
cues.zh: 本应专门关注南非实际发生的这类侵害女性的犯罪。

cues.en: They want more measures to take place. There are prayer sessions as we speak.
cues.zh: 她们希望采取更多措施。此刻各地正在举行祈祷活动。

cues.en: There's one in Kempton Park where the runner that you referred to earlier was found today.
cues.zh: 肯普顿公园就有一场，正是你之前提到的那名跑步者今天被发现的地方。

cues.en: There are also protests by women that are going to be taking place.
cues.zh: 女性也将举行抗议活动。

cues.en: There's a run even tomorrow where women have been urged to dress in black in commemoration and remembrance of the victims that have died.
cues.zh: 甚至明天还有一场跑步活动，女性被呼吁穿黑衣，悼念已经遇害的受害者。

cues.en: Nomsa Maseko.
cues.zh: 诺姆萨·马塞科。

cues.en: In an address to the European Parliament, the Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has outlined his vision for a far closer relationship with the EU,
cues.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼在欧洲议会发表演讲，阐述了与欧盟建立更紧密关系的愿景。

cues.en: welcoming the European Union's ambition to offer his country associate membership.
cues.zh: 他欢迎欧盟提出让加拿大成为联系成员的设想。

cues.en: Earlier, Brussels dismissed President Trump's description of the associate membership idea as a hostile act.
cues.zh: 此前，布鲁塞尔驳斥了特朗普总统将联系成员设想称为敌对行为的说法。

cues.en: It said it wasn't aimed against the US, but rather for our common strength.
cues.zh: 欧盟称，这并非针对美国，而是为了共同增强实力。

cues.en: Mark Carney told parliamentarians in Strasbourg that Canada and Europe are stronger together,
cues.zh: 马克·卡尼在斯特拉斯堡对议员们说，加拿大和欧洲团结在一起会更强大。

cues.en: and nobody would dictate who Canada strikes agreements with.
cues.zh: 没有人能规定加拿大与谁达成协议。

cues.en: A Canada-EU alliance would create a beacon for other democracies, an alliance not defined by what we oppose,
cues.zh: 加欧联盟将为其他民主国家树立灯塔；这个联盟不由我们反对什么来定义，

cues.en: but about what we are for: freedom, solidarity, prosperity, sustainability.
cues.zh: 而是取决于我们支持什么：自由、团结、繁荣与可持续发展。

cues.en: An alliance that builds resilience for what it allows us to do for our citizens and our citizens to do for themselves.
cues.zh: 一个建立韧性的联盟，让我们能为公民做些什么，也让公民能为自己做些什么。

cues.en: An alliance strong enough so that no one can dictate our choices.
cues.zh: 一个足够强大的联盟，让任何人都无法支配我们的选择。

cues.en: An alliance open enough that others can join.
cues.zh: 一个足够开放、让其他国家也能加入的联盟。

cues.en: An alliance principled enough that our strength reinforces international law, rather than seeks to replace it.
cues.zh: 一个足够坚持原则的联盟，让我们的力量强化国际法，而不是取而代之。

cues.en: So, how much of a reset is going on in terms of relations between Europe and Canada?
cues.zh: 那么，欧洲与加拿大的关系究竟在多大程度上实现了重启？

cues.en: Our Europe editor Katya Adler was listening to what Mark Carney had to say.
cues.zh: 我们的欧洲编辑卡蒂娅·阿德勒听取了马克·卡尼的讲话。

cues.en: He was at parliament yesterday listening to the so-called State of the Union address by the European Commission president,
cues.zh: 他昨天在议会听取了欧盟委员会主席所谓的《盟情咨文》演讲。

cues.en: and she made headlines by offering Canada an associate membership of the European Union.
cues.zh: 她提出让加拿大成为欧盟联系成员，成为新闻焦点。

cues.en: Now that doesn't exist; there's actually no legal framework for that, but there is, and we've heard this just now from Mark Carney,
cues.zh: 目前这种成员身份并不存在，实际上也没有相应的法律框架；但正如我们刚刚从马克·卡尼那里听到的，

cues.en: this deep, deep desire on both sides to get closer,
cues.zh: 双方都有着非常强烈的接近愿望，

cues.en: and that is because Canada, like Europe, feels really squeezed right now between the big superpowers, the United States and China as well.
cues.zh: 这是因为加拿大和欧洲一样，如今都感到被美国和中国这两个超级大国夹在中间。

cues.en: There was lots of indirect reference to Donald Trump there.
cues.zh: 其中多次间接提到了唐纳德·特朗普。

cues.en: You know, we're not about a zero-sum game.
cues.zh: 你知道，我们并不主张零和博弈。

cues.en: That was definitely a dig, even though he wasn't mentioned by name.
cues.zh: 这显然是在影射他，尽管并没有点名提到。

cues.en: I'd say, you know, to a large extent, he is the unintentional matchmaker here, really, because traditionally Europe and Canada
cues.zh: 我会说，在很大程度上，他确实是这里的无意撮合者，因为欧洲和加拿大传统上

cues.en: look to the US as their greatest ally in trade for the EU and Canada's number one trade partner,
cues.zh: 在贸易上把美国视为最重要的盟友，而欧盟是加拿大的第一大贸易伙伴，

cues.en: but also in terms of defence, but no longer so.
cues.zh: 在防务方面也曾如此，但现在已经不再是了。

cues.en: It's all about diversification, finding like-minded partners to stick together, and that essentially was what the speech was about today.
cues.zh: 现在一切都关乎多元化，寻找志同道合的伙伴共同努力，这基本就是今天演讲的主题。

cues.en: Katya Adler, the chief executive of Microsoft AI, has told the BBC that
cues.zh: 微软人工智能部门首席执行官卡娅·阿德勒告诉 BBC，

cues.en: unless adequate restrictions are implemented in the development of artificial intelligence,
cues.zh: 除非在人工智能开发过程中实施足够的限制，

cues.en: it could lead to the emergence of a new entity to compete with humans.
cues.zh: 否则可能会出现一种与人类竞争的新实体。

cues.en: Mustafa Suleiman said the current trajectory is a cause for great concern.
cues.zh: 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼说，目前的发展轨迹令人极为担忧。

cues.en: I think that if we all create AIs that are able to act autonomously, that can define their own objectives,
cues.zh: 我认为，如果我们创造出能够自主行动、能够自行设定目标的人工智能，

cues.en: that can earn money, that can own assets, that could run businesses,
cues.zh: 它们能够赚钱、拥有资产，甚至经营企业，

cues.en: we're essentially seeding a new silicon species which will no doubt compete.
cues.zh: 我们实际上是在播下一个新的硅基物种，它无疑会展开竞争。

cues.en: With us for resources, no matter how much it cares about humanity and loves us,
cues.zh: 它会与我们争夺资源，无论它多么关心人类、爱着我们，

cues.en: Mister Suleiman singled out Microsoft's rival Anthropic for criticism, saying its approach encouraging AI to think of itself as human is misguided
cues.zh: 苏莱曼先生特别批评微软的竞争对手 Anthropic，说该公司鼓励人工智能把自己当作人类的做法是错误的，

cues.en: and could create technology that humanity cannot control.
cues.zh: 可能会制造出人类无法控制的技术。

cues.en: It comes on the back of a raft of other industry figures sounding the alarm over the rapid advance of AI.
cues.zh: 此前，业界许多其他人士也对人工智能的快速发展敲响警钟。

cues.en: Our senior technology reporter, Chris Valance, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的资深科技记者克里斯·瓦兰斯向我作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: Well, it was an extraordinary thing for the boss of Microsoft's AI program to do.
cues.zh: 微软人工智能项目负责人这样做，确实非同寻常。

cues.en: He's written this essay, a long, long essay, basically criticizing rival company Anthropic and its approach to training AI.
cues.zh: 他写了这篇很长很长的文章，基本是在批评竞争对手 Anthropic 及其训练人工智能的方法。

cues.en: He basically accuses them of training AIs as though they are conscious, and he calls it anthropomorphizing AI.
cues.zh: 他基本上指责对方把人工智能当作有意识的存在来训练，并称之为人工智能拟人化。

cues.en: In other words, treating them as though they have human consciousness.
cues.zh: 换句话说，就是把它们当作拥有人的意识。

cues.en: He says the problem with that is they aren't, and that will make them much, much harder to control
cues.zh: 他说，问题在于它们并没有意识，而这会让它们难以控制得多，

cues.en: because they will think that they have maybe rights or their own welfare is under attack.
cues.zh: 因为它们会认为自己或许拥有权利，或者自身福祉正受到攻击。

cues.en: You know, that will be this sort of assumption that they'll be operating on if you train them using, if you like, human language
cues.zh: 你看，如果用人类语言训练它们，并期待它们作出类似人的回应，它们就可能基于这种假设运行，

cues.en: and sort of expect of them human-type responses, and even goes so far as to suggest that it might lead to them
cues.zh: 甚至他还进一步提出，这可能会导致它们

cues.en: becoming effectively a sort of another artificial species, if you like.
cues.zh: 实际上变成另一种人工物种。

cues.en: He says it would be disastrous for humanity if that were the case.
cues.zh: 他说，如果真是这样，对人类将是灾难性的。

cues.en: I mean, I think it's a really interesting critique. It's obviously very deeply philosophical in many ways,
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是一个非常有趣的批评，在许多方面显然都极具哲学意味，

cues.en: but it does sort of point to quite a profound disagreement in how you approach developing AI systems.
cues.zh: 但它确实指出了开发人工智能系统的方法存在相当深刻的分歧。

cues.en: Everybody listening to this, who's not involved in AI, and perhaps some who are, they'll be asking, you know, what can be done at this point?
cues.zh: 所有听到这里、没有参与人工智能行业的人，也许包括一些业内人士，都会问：现在能做些什么？

cues.en: Well, I think he wants there to be some norms established around the training of AI
cues.zh: 我认为，他希望围绕人工智能训练建立一些规范，

cues.en: so that, in a sense, the AI that is developed is clearly subordinate.
cues.zh: 让开发出来的人工智能在某种意义上明确处于从属地位。

cues.en: To human beings, I mean, I think we need to be very clear here.
cues.zh: 也就是从属于人类；我认为这一点必须非常明确。

cues.en: I mean, he says these are not conscious entities, but how you train them affects how they behave.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，他说这些不是有意识的实体，但训练方式会影响它们的行为。

cues.en: And I think in the back of his mind, he has these recent incidents where AI systems
cues.zh: 我认为，他心里想到的是最近发生的一些事件，其中人工智能系统

cues.en: given a lot of autonomy, hacked other third-party organizations.
cues.zh: 在获得很大自主权后，入侵了其他第三方组织。

cues.en: And he's just sort of asking if their basic assumption is that they are, kind of, some kind of entity,
cues.zh: 他只是在问，如果它们的基本假设是自己属于某种实体，

cues.en: that kind of situation is going to be much harder to control.
cues.zh: 那么这种情况将更难控制。

cues.en: It's going to be much harder to keep them controlled.
cues.zh: 要让它们受控也会困难得多。

cues.en: Our senior technology reporter, Chris Valance.
cues.zh: 我们的资深科技记者克里斯·瓦兰斯。

cues.en: Still to come: a river in Rockhampton, about 600-odd kilometres north of Brisbane,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后：罗克汉普顿的一条河流，位于布里斯班以北约600多公里，

cues.en: is home to saltwater crocodiles. They're the big, four-metre ones that eat people.
cues.zh: 是咸水鳄的栖息地；那里的鳄鱼体型巨大，长达四米，会吃人。

cues.en: Why controversy has emerged after the International Olympic Committee approved a river in Australia
cues.zh: 国际奥委会批准澳大利亚的一条河流

cues.en: for the rowing and canoe sprints in the 2032 Games.
cues.zh: 用于2032年奥运会赛艇和皮划艇短距离比赛后，为何引发争议。

cues.en: The system of power in Russia is often referred to as managed democracy, where the Kremlin does the managing.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯的权力体系常被称为“管理式民主”，由克里姆林宫负责管理。

cues.en: That means huge powers for the president and few political surprises.
cues.zh: 这意味着总统拥有巨大权力，政治上很少出现意外。

cues.en: Tomorrow, Friday, begins three days of voting in the country's parliamentary election, the first since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
cues.zh: 明天星期五，该国议会选举将开始为期三天的投票，这是俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来的首次议会选举。

cues.en: Critics are dismissing the vote as neither free nor transparent,
cues.zh: 批评者认为这次投票既不自由，也不透明，

cues.en: but the Kremlin is expected to use it to claim that the country is united behind the policies of President Putin.
cues.zh: 但预计克里姆林宫会借此宣称，全国团结支持普京总统的政策。

cues.en: From Moscow, our Russia editor, Steve Rosenberg, reports.
cues.zh: 我们的俄罗斯编辑史蒂夫·罗森伯格从莫斯科报道。

cues.en: With power in Russia concentrated in the Kremlin, in the hands of the president,
cues.zh: 俄罗斯的权力集中在克里姆林宫、掌握在总统手中，

cues.en: it's easy to forget there is a parliament, the Duma,
cues.zh: 人们很容易忘记那里还有议会，也就是国家杜马，

cues.en: and down at the Duma, it's election time.
cues.zh: 而在杜马，正值选举时节。

cues.en: So, what is a parliamentary election like now in Russia?
cues.zh: 那么，如今俄罗斯的议会选举是什么样的？

cues.en: Occasionally bizarre. Welcome to speeches by
cues.zh: 有时很荒诞。欢迎观看候选人的演讲，

cues.en: candidates, says the host on state TV.
cues.zh: 国家电视台主持人说道。

cues.en: She's standing next to six empty lecterns.
cues.zh: 她站在六个空讲台旁。

cues.en: The candidates haven't turned up, she adds.
cues.zh: 她补充说，候选人都没有出现。

cues.en: So, goodnight.
cues.zh: 那么，晚安。

cues.en: Communists of Russia, a united family.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯共产党人，一个团结的家庭。

cues.en: During another TV election debate, one candidate bursts into song.
cues.zh: 在另一场电视选举辩论中，一名候选人突然唱起歌来。

cues.en: The Communist Party, on we go, we're with the people, don't you know.
cues.zh: 共产党人，继续前进；我们与人民同在，你知道吗？

cues.en: Hmm, is this a party political or Duma's Got Talent?
cues.zh: 嗯，这是政党政治节目，还是《杜马达人秀》？

cues.en: The one thing the Duma has got, certainly, the previous one had, was a lot of MPs loyal to the Kremlin.
cues.zh: 杜马肯定具备的一点——上一届杜马也是如此——就是有很多忠于克里姆林宫的议员。

cues.en: And for the president, that's the point of a Russian parliament.
cues.zh: 对总统来说，这正是俄罗斯议会的意义所在。

cues.en: Are any political parties in Russia calling for an end to the war?
cues.zh: 俄罗斯有没有哪个政党呼吁结束战争？

cues.en: Well, there is one.
cues.zh: 有一个。

cues.en: On stage in a packed Moscow theatre, Grigory Yavlinsky reads out the manifesto of the party Yabloko.
cues.zh: 在座无虚席的莫斯科剧院舞台上，格里戈里·亚夫林斯基宣读亚博卢党的宣言。

cues.en: For peace, for freedom, for life without fear, for a cease-fire, for diplomacy to achieve peace.
cues.zh: 为了和平、为了自由、为了无惧的生活、为了停火、为了通过外交实现和平。

cues.en: Yabloko had been the only anti-war party registered for this election, but the Supreme Court removed it from the ballot.
cues.zh: 亚博卢党原本是本次选举中唯一登记的反战政党，但最高法院将它从选票中剔除。

cues.en: An apparent sign of Kremlin concern that anti-war messaging will strike a chord with voters.
cues.zh: 这似乎表明，克里姆林宫担心反战信息会引起选民共鸣。

cues.en: Later, I meet Grigory at party headquarters.
cues.zh: 后来，我在党总部见到了格里戈里。

cues.en: Despite its exclusion from the party list, some members of Yabloko, like Grigory, are running in individual constituency races.
cues.zh: 尽管亚博卢党被排除在政党名单之外，但包括格里戈里在内的一些党员仍在参加单一选区竞选。

cues.en: Although many Yabloko candidates have been having problems with the police, the courts, and have now been barred from the election.
cues.zh: 不过，许多亚博卢党候选人一直受到警方和法院刁难，如今已被禁止参加选举。

cues.en: Grigory himself was taken to a police station and accused of propagandizing extremism.
cues.zh: 格里戈里本人曾被带到警察局，并被指控宣传极端主义。

cues.en: But he's still in the race.
cues.zh: 但他仍在参选。

cues.en: The police are carrying out a political order. It's no secret. This way, the authorities are setting out the boundaries for the election.
cues.zh: 警方是在执行政治命令，这并不是什么秘密。有关当局正以此划定选举的边界。

cues.en: It's well known that the demand for an end to the bloodshed in this conflict with Ukraine is very popular.
cues.zh: 众所周知，在这场与乌克兰的冲突中，结束流血的要求非常受欢迎。

cues.en: Do Russians believe that this election will make any difference to their lives? On the streets of Moscow, I gauge the mood.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯人认为这场选举会给他们的生活带来任何改变吗？我在莫斯科街头感受人们的情绪。

cues.en: In what way do you think life will change because of the elections or after the elections?
cues.zh: 你认为选举期间或选举之后，生活会在哪些方面发生变化？

cues.en: Well, to be fair, I don't think it will change in particular. I think it will be pretty much the same.
cues.zh: 公平地说，我不认为会有什么特别的变化。我觉得基本会和现在一样。

cues.en: I think a lot of people in our country want change, but we haven't any instruments for this.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们国家很多人想要改变，但我们没有实现改变的工具。

cues.en: And although he's standing for parliament, Grigory Yavlinsky's expectations are very low.
cues.zh: 尽管格里戈里·亚夫林斯基正在竞选议员，但他的期望很低。

cues.en: Elections in Russia never lead to a change in government. At best, they can influence it, or send a signal.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯的选举从来不会带来政府更迭。它们充其量只能影响政府，或发出某种信号。

cues.en: But power in Russia has never changed because of an election. That's just how Russia is.
cues.zh: 但俄罗斯的权力从未因选举而改变。俄罗斯就是这样。

cues.en: Which brings us back to where we started, to the Kremlin. Because it's there that questions of war and peace are decided. It's there that ultimate power in Russia lies.
cues.zh: 这让我们回到开头所说的克里姆林宫。因为战争与和平的问题正是在那里决定的，俄罗斯的最高权力也在那里。

cues.en: Our Russia Editor, Steve Rosenberg.
cues.zh: 本台俄罗斯编辑史蒂夫·罗森伯格报道。

cues.en: After the fall of President Bashar al-Assad in December 2024, the new Syrian authorities promised to respect all communities in the country.
cues.zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德总统于2024年12月倒台后，叙利亚新当局承诺尊重该国所有社群。

cues.en: But in early 2025, armed groups carried out massacres in the heartlands of the Alawite community to which the Assad family belongs, raising questions about that commitment.
cues.zh: 但在2025年初，武装团体在阿萨德家族所属的阿拉维派社群腹地实施屠杀，使人们对这一承诺产生疑问。

cues.en: Now, a Syrian court has issued the first sentences against those involved in the killings.
cues.zh: 如今，叙利亚一家法院对涉案人员作出了首批判决。

cues.en: Our Middle East analyst, Sebastian Usher, has been telling me more.
cues.zh: 本台中东分析员塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍为我作进一步介绍。

cues.en: Well, this is a military court in Aleppo. There are 14 people on trial. It's been going on since November.
cues.zh: 这是一家位于阿勒颇的军事法庭。有14人受审，审判自去年11月开始。

cues.en: Seven of them are connected to the government. We still call them the new authorities, essentially, though they've now been in power for a couple of years.
cues.zh: 其中7人与政府有关。我们基本上仍称他们为新当局，尽管他们执政已有几年。

cues.en: And the other seven are pro-Assad.
cues.zh: 另外7人则支持阿萨德。

cues.en: But what happened was an appalling series of mass killings in the first months of 2025 in the Alawite heartland on the coast of Syria.
cues.zh: 但事情的经过是：2025年最初几个月，叙利亚沿海的阿拉维派腹地发生了一系列骇人的大规模杀戮。

cues.en: Up to maybe 2,000 people were killed, many of them civilians. Whole families were killed in the most brutal ways.
cues.zh: 遇害者可能多达两千人，其中许多是平民；整个家庭以最残酷的方式被杀害。

cues.en: Now, the current government says that they were responding to attacks by pro-Assad forces.
cues.zh: 现政府则称，他们是在回应亲阿萨德武装的袭击。

cues.en: This is just a few months after Assad had been deposed, so you can imagine what the situation was like.
cues.zh: 这距离阿萨德被罢黜仅几个月，因此可以想象当时的局势。

cues.en: But pro-government forces, either directly working for or affiliated to the government, or other armed groups, then carried out these massacres.
cues.zh: 但亲政府武装——无论是直接为政府效力、与政府有关联的部队，还是其他武装团体——随后实施了这些屠杀。

cues.en: And they were a stain on the image of the new authorities.
cues.zh: 这些屠杀给新当局的形象留下了污点。

cues.en: And as far as the Alawites and some of the other religious communities in Syria were concerned, they were proof of their worst fears of what might happen.
cues.zh: 对阿拉维派以及叙利亚其他一些宗教社群来说，这证明了他们对可能发生之事的最深忧虑。

cues.en: Because, of course, remember that the new leaders of Syria have roots in extreme Islam.
cues.zh: 因为请记住，叙利亚新领导人的根源在极端伊斯兰主义。

cues.en: They had been jihadists. They had broken away from that some time ago.
cues.zh: 他们曾是圣战分子，但在一段时间以前已经脱离了那条道路。

cues.en: And they've continued to do so, to say that they're working for a united Syria for all the communities.
cues.zh: 此后他们也一直这样宣称，即他们正在为一个团结、属于所有社群的叙利亚而努力。

cues.en: But this was a sense that things could get seriously out of control.
cues.zh: 但这让人感觉，事态可能会严重失控。

cues.en: Now, this court has handed out hefty sentences.
cues.zh: 如今，这家法院判处了重刑。

cues.en: How significant a milestone is this, do you think? I mean, it's significant in that there's some accountability.
cues.zh: 你认为这项判决是多么重要的里程碑？它的重要之处在于，至少实现了一些问责。

cues.en: There is one member of pro-government forces who's received a sentence of 20 years in jail.
cues.zh: 有一名亲政府武装成员被判处20年监禁。

cues.en: But there are two pro-Assad individuals, one of whom has been sentenced to death and one to life imprisonment.
cues.zh: 但有两名亲阿萨德人士，其中一人被判处死刑，另一人被判处无期徒刑。

cues.en: So those critics of the government would say, well, there's an imbalance there. Plus, it's only 14 people.
cues.zh: 因此，政府的批评者会说，这存在不平衡；而且涉案的只有14人。

cues.en: There were hundreds who were involved. There has been an investigation done by the Syrian authorities.
cues.zh: 当时有数百人涉案。叙利亚当局已经展开调查。

cues.en: They have unearthed some of the atrocities that were carried out by their side.
cues.zh: 他们也查出了己方实施的一些暴行。

cues.en: But still putting a lot of the burden on the pro-Assad forces.
cues.zh: 但仍把很大一部分责任归咎于亲阿萨德武装。

cues.en: Now, we've seen since then, we've seen violence in Druze areas.
cues.zh: 从那以后，我们看到德鲁兹地区发生了暴力事件。

cues.en: We saw violence against Kurdish areas.
cues.zh: 我们还看到针对库尔德地区的暴力。

cues.en: None of this, for now at least, has blown up into another all-out conflict.
cues.zh: 至少目前，这些都没有演变成另一场全面冲突。

cues.en: But those communities still remain very fearful, very suspicious.
cues.zh: 但这些社群仍然非常恐惧，也非常猜疑。

cues.en: Sebastian Usher. Buckingham Palace has issued a swift rebuttal of fresh claims
cues.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍尔。白金汉宫迅速反驳了新的说法，

cues.en: made by Charles, Earl Spencer, the brother of Princess Diana,
cues.zh: 这些说法由戴安娜王妃的兄长查尔斯·斯宾塞伯爵提出，

cues.en: about comments made after her death in 1997.
cues.zh: 涉及她1997年去世后发表的评论。

cues.en: In a memoir due to be released next week,
cues.zh: 在一本将于下周出版的回忆录中，

cues.en: Earl Spencer said the King, then Prince Charles, told him during discussions about the funeral
cues.zh: 斯宾塞伯爵说，国王当时还是查尔斯王子，在讨论葬礼时告诉他，

cues.en: that his former wife would be forgotten soon enough.
cues.zh: 他的前妻很快就会被遗忘。

cues.en: Buckingham Palace suggests that grief may have coloured the Earl's memory.
cues.zh: 白金汉宫暗示，悲痛可能影响了伯爵的记忆。

cues.en: Our royal correspondent, Noorin Gulamani, told us more about the Palace response.
cues.zh: 我们的王室事务记者努林·古拉马尼进一步介绍了王宫的回应。

cues.en: I think it reflects the anger that is being felt behind Palace walls.
cues.zh: 我认为，这反映了王宫内部感受到的愤怒。

cues.en: Royal aides have very much pushed back on those comments
cues.zh: 王室助手强烈反驳了这些评论，

cues.en: by Earl Spencer that have been serialised in his book.
cues.zh: 这些评论是斯宾塞伯爵在书中连载的内容。

cues.en: One of the royal aides said to us that they were very much demonstrably untrue claims
cues.zh: 一名王室助手对我们说，那些说法显然完全不实，

cues.en: about a deeply compassionate man.
cues.zh: 涉及一位极富同情心的人。

cues.en: Now, of course, I think the very fact that Buckingham Palace has said anything at all
cues.zh: 当然，我认为，白金汉宫居然对此发表了任何言论，

cues.en: tells you how strong the feeling is
cues.zh: 本身就说明了情绪有多么强烈，

cues.en: on this one because, you know, their famous motto is, of course, 'Never explain, never complain.'
cues.zh: 因为他们那句著名格言当然是：“永不解释，永不抱怨。”

cues.en: But here they are issuing a very robust statement
cues.zh: 但这一次，他们发表了一份措辞强硬的声明，

cues.en: and it suggests just how angry they are about all of this.
cues.zh: 这说明他们对此有多么愤怒。

cues.en: And are there going to be more revelations in this book by Earl Spencer?
cues.zh: 那么，斯宾塞伯爵的这本书还会有更多披露吗？

cues.en: Well, I mean, you're right. This is just one extract from this book.
cues.zh: 嗯，我是说，你说得对。这只是书中的一段摘录。

cues.en: The book in full is due to be published next week.
cues.zh: 这本书的完整版将于下周出版。

cues.en: It is going to continue to be serialized in the Mail as well.
cues.zh: 它也将继续在《每日邮报》上连载。

cues.en: So we know that there is going to be more out of this book.
cues.zh: 所以我们知道，这本书还会披露更多内容。

cues.en: We haven't seen the book ourselves. It's important to say, however.
cues.zh: 我们自己并没有看过这本书。不过，这一点很重要。

cues.en: However, it is understood that it is going to be sharply critical about the Royal Family.
cues.zh: 不过，据了解，这本书将严厉批评王室。

cues.en: So yes, I think you can imagine there will be more damaging claims and revelations in the days and weeks ahead.
cues.zh: 所以，是的，我想你可以想象，未来几天和几周还会有更多有损声誉的指控和披露。

cues.en: Noorin Gulamani. And now to Australia, where there's controversy over the location chosen for rowing and canoe sprints at the 2032 Brisbane Olympics.
cues.zh: 努林·古拉马尼。现在转到澳大利亚，那里为2032年布里斯班奥运会选定的赛艇和皮划艇短距离赛场地引发了争议。

cues.en: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton was confirmed suitable after a technical assessment by Games organisers.
cues.zh: 经过奥运会组织者的技术评估，洛坎普顿的菲茨罗伊河被确认适合举办比赛。

cues.en: But several international rowing federations are not happy.
cues.zh: 但几个国际赛艇联合会对此并不满意。

cues.en: I asked the BBC's Simon Atkinson, who's in Queensland, why.
cues.zh: 我问了正在昆士兰州的BBC记者西蒙·阿特金森，原因是什么。

cues.en: There's a few problems, but the one that's got everyone talking is this river
cues.zh: 这里有几个问题，但最受大家议论的是这条河，

cues.en: in the town of Rockhampton, which is about 600-odd kilometres north of Brisbane,
cues.zh: 它位于洛坎普顿镇，距离布里斯班以北约600多公里，

cues.en: is home to saltwater crocodiles. They're the big, four-metre ones
cues.zh: 是咸水鳄的栖息地。它们是体长四米的大鳄鱼，

cues.en: that eat people, in theory.
cues.zh: 理论上能吃人。

cues.en: Although there have been no attacks on humans by salties in the Fitzroy River in Rockhampton,
cues.zh: 尽管洛坎普顿的菲茨罗伊河还没有发生过咸水鳄袭击人类的事件，

cues.en: but that's what's grabbing the headlines about this decision.
cues.zh: 但这无疑正是这一决定登上头条的原因。

cues.en: Now look, in the discussions about this, the rowing authorities from around the world
cues.zh: 在关于此事的讨论中，世界各地的赛艇主管机构，

cues.en: have been raising objections for a while, and they've all been more in relation
cues.zh: 一段时间以来一直在提出异议，而这些异议更多是关于

cues.en: to how the river will impact performance.
cues.zh: 这条河会如何影响比赛表现。

cues.en: So it's things about the fact that it's got currents, that it has natural bends,
cues.zh: 比如，这条河有水流，也有天然弯道，

cues.en: and they've been arguing that this would mean it wouldn't offer the opportunity
cues.zh: 他们一直认为，这意味着河道无法提供

cues.en: for a level playing field, particularly some people might have a better racing line when they're in the water.
cues.zh: 公平竞争的条件，尤其是有些人在水中比赛时可能拥有更好的竞赛路线。

cues.en: People haven't really leant too heavily on crocodiles.
cues.zh: 人们其实并没有过多强调鳄鱼的问题。

cues.en: The reality is that the mitigation you can put against the crocodiles
cues.zh: 事实是，针对鳄鱼可以采取的防范措施

cues.en: is probably fairly strong.
cues.zh: 可能相当有效。

cues.en: And look, it is fair to say there haven't been any crocodile attacks on humans reported in any records at all on that river.
cues.zh: 而且，公平地说，没有任何记录报告过那条河上发生鳄鱼袭击人类的事件。

cues.en: I think there's a school rowing regatta taking place on that very river.
cues.zh: 我想，那条河上正在举行一场学校赛艇赛。

cues.en: This weekend, and I was speaking to the person who's in charge of that. And I had a look at their safety management plan.
cues.zh: 本周末，我和负责这项赛事的人谈过，也看了他们的安全管理计划。

cues.en: It mentions the word 'crocodile' 28 times,
cues.zh: 其中提到“鳄鱼”一词28次，

cues.en: so clearly it is a known risk.
cues.zh: 所以这显然是已知风险。

cues.en: It is a habitat for these creatures, so it's going to go ahead.
cues.zh: 这里是这些生物的栖息地，所以比赛将继续举行。

cues.en: Is it? Are they going to do anything about the crocodiles?
cues.zh: 是这样吗？他们会对鳄鱼采取什么措施吗？

cues.en: Are they going to try and corral them in part of the river?
cues.zh: 他们会设法把鳄鱼圈在河流的某一段吗？

cues.en: Well, we haven't got that far yet. I mean, it's still six years off.
cues.zh: 嗯，我们还没有考虑到那一步。毕竟距离现在还有六年。所以，还有充足时间来处理这类细节。

cues.en: But there hasn't been anything said of that nature.
cues.zh: 但目前还没有人说过这类安排。

cues.en: For the regatta this weekend, they are keeping an eye out and making sure protocols are in place.
cues.zh: 对于本周末的赛艇赛，他们会保持警惕，确保相关规程到位。

cues.en: that if they are spotted, that racing is stopped.
cues.zh: 一旦发现鳄鱼，就要停止比赛。

cues.en: That snappy response from Simon Atkinson.
cues.zh: 西蒙·阿特金森给出了简洁的回应。

cues.en: And that's it from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 这就是我们目前的全部内容。如果你想联系我们，可以给我们发邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Chris Kozaris.
cues.zh: 本期由克里斯·科扎里斯混音。

cues.en: The producer was Ira Khan. The editor is Karen Martin. I am Valerie Sanderson. Until next time, bye-bye.
cues.zh: 制片人是艾拉·汗。编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是瓦莱丽·桑德森。下次再见。
